months.title: Data is the product
months.subject: Python and data foundations
months.summary: Write Python that loads, cleans and checks product data on your own, and learn why BOM quality decides every AI project.
months.build: Project 1, a BOM health checker that compares an EBOM with an MBOM and reports every mismatch.

videos.title: Kaggle Learn: Python
videos.note: Seven short lessons with exercises that run in the browser. Units 1 and 2.

videos.title: Kaggle Learn: Pandas
videos.note: Six lessons on the library you will use in every lab. Units 2 and 3.

videos.title: Python for Everybody
videos.note: Slower, friendlier videos. Use it as a second explanation whenever Kaggle feels fast.

videos.title: Generative AI for Everyone
videos.note: A non-technical overview of what GenAI can and cannot do. Watch alongside the case studies.

free.title: Python for Everybody (book)
free.by: Charles Severance · free online and as a PDF
free.sections: Chapters 1 to 10: variables, conditionals, functions, loops, strings, files, lists, dictionaries and tuples.

free.title: Python Data Science Handbook
free.by: Jake VanderPlas · free to read online
free.sections: Chapter 3, Data Manipulation with Pandas: Series, DataFrames, indexing, missing data, merge and join, groupby.

free.title: pandas: 10 minutes to pandas
free.sections: The whole page. Keep it open as a reference during the labs.

data.title: Google Colab
data.sections: Where you run every lab in Parts 1 to 3. Needs only a Google account.

data.title: GitHub Skills: Introduction to GitHub
data.sections: A guided first repository. Your portfolio lives on GitHub from Unit 1.

months.title: Learning from data and images
months.subject: Machine learning and deep learning essentials
months.summary: Train and evaluate a model on machine sensor data, train an image classifier for defects, and understand how generative models produce text, images and shapes.
months.build: Project 2, a predictive maintenance model on AI4I 2020 with an honest ROI sheet, plus a small defect classifier.

videos.title: Machine Learning Crash Course
videos.note: Linear and logistic regression, classification metrics, overfitting. The best free short course on the basics.

videos.title: Kaggle Learn: Intro to Machine Learning
videos.note: Decision trees and random forests in scikit-learn, hands on. Units 5 and 6.

videos.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
videos.note: Lessons 1 to 3 match Units 9 to 11. Code-first, runs on free Kaggle or Colab GPUs.

videos.title: Neural networks
videos.note: The clearest visual explanation of what a network learns. Chapters 1 to 3.

videos.title: But what is a GPT? Visual intro to transformers
videos.note: Chapter 5 of the neural networks series. The bridge from deep learning to generative AI in Unit 8.

free.title: scikit-learn user guide
free.sections: Sections 1.10 (decision trees), 1.11 (ensembles) and 3.4 (metrics and scoring). Read the examples, skip the maths on first pass.

free.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning (Python edition)
free.by: James, Witten, Hastie, Tibshirani and Taylor · free PDF from the authors
free.sections: Chapter 2 (what statistical learning is), Chapter 4 (classification) and Chapter 8 (tree-based methods).

free.title: Dive into Deep Learning
free.by: Zhang, Lipton, Li and Smola · free online
free.sections: Chapter 5 (multilayer perceptrons), Chapter 7 (convolutional networks) and Chapter 14.2 (fine-tuning).

data.title: AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance Dataset
data.sections: 10,000 rows of synthetic but realistic milling-machine readings with failure labels. Used in every lab this month.

data.title: Casting product image data for quality inspection
data.sections: About 7,000 grey-scale images of submersible pump impellers, labelled OK or defective. Used in Units 9 to 12.

data.title: Kaggle Notebooks
data.sections: About 30 hours of free GPU time a week. Use it for the image lab in Unit 7.

months.title: Generative AI that knows your documents
months.subject: Large language models, prompting, embeddings and RAG
months.summary: Learn how LLMs work and fail, get reliable structured output from them, and build a copilot that answers from engineering documents with citations.
months.build: Project 3, a PLM document copilot on a free open model, with a 20-question evaluation set.

videos.title: Intro to Large Language Models
videos.note: One hour on what an LLM is, how it is trained and where it breaks. Unit 13.

videos.title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
videos.note: Three and a half hours. Watch in parts across Units 13 to 17.

videos.title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers
videos.note: Prompting from Python. The ideas apply to any model, including the free local ones you will use.

videos.title: DeepLearning.AI short courses
videos.note: Pick one RAG or vector-database course in Unit 15. Most are about an hour.

free.title: Hugging Face LLM Course
free.sections: Chapter 1 (transformer models) and the section on tokenizers.

free.title: Prompt engineering interactive tutorial
free.sections: The prompt engineering tutorial, chapters 1 to 6. Works with any model if you swap the API call.

free.title: Chroma documentation
free.sections: Getting started and the guide on embeddings. Chroma is the vector store used in the labs.

data.title: Ollama
data.by: Run open models on your own laptop
data.sections: Free. A 3 to 4 billion parameter model runs on a laptop with 8 to 16 GB of RAM.

data.title: Gemini API free tier
data.sections: A free hosted model with rate limits, as a backup if your laptop is too slow. Never send customer data.

data.title: Streamlit documentation
data.sections: The tutorial on building a chat app. Used for the copilot's front end.

months.title: Agents that do engineering work
months.subject: Agentic AI: tool calling, agent loops and workflow patterns
months.summary: Give a model tools, write an agent loop from scratch, learn the workflow patterns that make agents reliable, and design human approval into every action.
months.build: Project 4, a change impact agent that reads a change request, queries the BOM and drafts an impact summary for approval.

videos.title: Hugging Face AI Agents Course
videos.note: Units 1 to 3. Free, hands-on and framework-neutral at the start.

videos.title: Functions, Tools and Agents with LangChain
videos.note: Tool calling and agent basics from Python. Optional: this course builds them by hand first.

free.title: Building effective agents
free.sections: The whole article. The clearest guide to when you need an agent and when a simple workflow is better.

free.title: SQLite tutorial
free.sections: SELECT, WHERE, JOIN and the section on recursive common table expressions, used for where-used queries.

free.title: Ollama tool calling
free.sections: How to pass tools to a local model, and which models support it.

data.title: Ollama
data.by: Run open models on your own laptop
data.sections: Use a tool-capable model such as qwen2.5 or llama3.1 for the labs this month.

months.title: MCP: plugging AI into PLM
months.subject: Model Context Protocol servers, clients and enterprise integration
months.summary: Learn how MCP connects AI applications to systems, build MCP servers that expose BOM, change and document data, and secure them for enterprise use.
months.build: Project 5, a set of PLM MCP servers (BOM, changes, documents) that any MCP host can use, tested with the MCP Inspector.

videos.title: Model Context Protocol documentation
videos.note: Read the introduction and core architecture before Unit 18, then follow the server quickstart in Unit 19.

videos.title: MCP: Build Rich-Context AI Apps with Anthropic
videos.note: Builds an MCP server and client in Python. A good second explanation for Units 19 and 20.

videos.title: Hugging Face MCP Course
videos.note: Free course on MCP concepts and building servers and clients.

free.title: MCP specification
free.sections: Architecture, the server features (tools, resources, prompts) and the authorization section. Read in Unit 21.

free.title: MCP Python SDK
free.sections: The README's quickstart and the FastMCP sections on tools, resources and prompts.

free.title: MCP Inspector
free.sections: The free browser tool for testing a server without any AI model.

data.title: Claude Desktop
data.by: Anthropic · the free plan can use local MCP servers
data.sections: One MCP host for trying your servers with a real assistant. Optional; the Inspector and your own client are enough.

data.title: MCP example servers
data.sections: Reference servers such as filesystem and SQLite. Read their code before writing your own.

months.title: From pilot to plant-wide
months.subject: Scaling GenAI and agents: evaluation, operations, governance and the business case
months.summary: Learn why most GenAI pilots never reach production, deploy and monitor your best system, and build the playbook and pitch you will use with customers.
months.build: Project 6, a deployed capstone: an agent using your MCP servers, with evaluation on every change, usage logs, an innovation twist and a 15-minute pitch.

videos.title: Made With ML
videos.note: Design, data, testing, deployment and monitoring of ML systems. The free MLOps course to follow.

videos.title: LLM Zoomcamp
videos.note: The modules on evaluation and monitoring of LLM applications. Unit 23.

free.title: EU AI Act explorer and summaries
free.sections: The high-level summary. Enough to answer customers' first governance questions.

free.title: Global Lighthouse Network
free.sections: Case summaries of factories that scaled digital and AI use cases. Read two in Unit 25.

free.title: Rules of Machine Learning
free.sections: Rules 16 to 43, on iterating and monitoring a model in production.

free.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
free.sections: Prompt injection, insecure output handling and excessive agency. Read in Unit 24.

data.title: Streamlit Community Cloud
data.sections: An alternative to Hugging Face Spaces for the capstone.

data.title: GitHub Actions
data.sections: The quickstart. Free for public repositories; used to run your evaluation on every change.
